# Daniel Silva — Senior Full Stack & AI Software Engineer

> Daniel Alejandro Silva Rojas ("Daniel Silva") is a Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of
> experience shipping production systems. He specializes in high-performance, low-latency and
> real-time architectures (Rust, C++, WebSockets), full-stack web development (Vue 3 / Nuxt 3,
> Node.js / FastAPI, Supabase / PostgreSQL) and applied AI / computer vision (OpenCV, PyTorch,
> FlowNet, Gemini Live, RAG). He is the founder and architect of DropAudio CCS, an e-commerce
> platform in production. Based in Caracas, Venezuela; available for remote roles. Fluent in
> Spanish (native) and English (B2, professional).

## Current roles
- Lead Performance & Systems Engineer — Ea2technology (Canada, remote), Jul 2021–present.
  Industrial Digital Twin for refinery monitoring; full-duplex WebSocket architecture that cut
  latency from 200–500 ms to 1–10 ms and reduced bandwidth up to 95%; AWS cloud-native
  microservices migration optimized with C++ and Rust.
- Founder & Software Architect — DropAudio CCS (https://dropaudioccs.com), Jun 2021–present.
  Complete Nuxt 3 + Supabase e-commerce in production: multi-currency checkout, interactive audio
  recommender, admin panel, 94+ verified reviews, technical SEO/GEO.
- Software Performance Consultant & Algorithm Engineer — Freelance / VIAAC (maritime-oil),
  Jan 2023–present. High-performance video stabilization (optical flow, FlowNet), custom
  TCP/WebSocket protocols, Rust/C++/Python (PyO3) performance audits.
